== The Emerald City of Oz ==

=== Infobox ===

* Name: Fuddlecumjig
* Region: Land of Oz

Fuddlecumjig is a destination within the Land of Oz, reached by a road marked with a sign-post reading "THIS WAY TO FUDDLECUMJIG." It is known as the home of the Fuddles, described as the most peculiar people in all the Land of Oz. Ozma is said to have thought that visitors might enjoy the Fuddles, prompting a detour to the place.
